package.name: joy
package.description: ROS 2 Humble remapping and launch helper for the upstream joy_linux driver. The original ROS 1 joy package provided a generic Linux joystick driver (joy_node) plus a YAML-driven axis/button remapper (joy_remap.py). In ROS 2 the driver is provided by the upstream joy_linux package as joy_linux/joy_linux_node; this package keeps the remapper and the PS4 launch configuration. The package deliberately has the same name as the historical ROS 1 package, so it must not depend on an ROS 2 package also named joy.
